criteria.label: Chunk quality
criteria.question: Do grouped items genuinely belong together?

criteria.label: Top-level burden
criteria.question: Does the schema reduce how many independent things I must hold in mind?

criteria.label: Hierarchy
criteria.question: Does parent/child organization reflect the concept rather than source order?

criteria.label: Shared mechanisms
criteria.question: Are examples organized under common mechanisms where supported?

criteria.label: Implications
criteria.question: Are crucial eventual or causal relationships preserved?

criteria.label: Traversal
criteria.question: Can I still follow the explanation naturally?

criteria.label: Schema utility
criteria.question: Does organization make retrieval and synthesis easier?

criteria.label: Over-grouping
criteria.question: Has useful distinction been hidden inside a broad chunk?

criteria.label: Under-grouping
criteria.question: Are too many sibling units still independent?

criteria.label: Fidelity
criteria.question: Are semantics, scope, uncertainty, causality, and provenance unchanged?

criteria.label: First learning versus review
criteria.question: Which view fits first exposure and which later retrieval?
